$comment: The parts of the candidate profile the site's JSON does not model, but the job-search framework needs. Kept here so data/ stays the single source of truth for both projects — scripts/build-profile-md.mjs folds this into .claude/skills/job-application-assistant/01-candidate-profile.md. Leave a field empty and the generated profile says so plainly rather than inventing one. Two things used to live here and no longer do: projects are a first-class entity in data/projects.json, and languages are in data/profile.json (edited in /editor/ → Basics, and published as schema.org knowsLanguage).
